data.desc: Acadia is a leading provider of behavioral healthcare services across the United States (the 'U.S.'). As of June 30, 2026, Acadia operated a network of 279 behavioral healthcare facilities with approximately 12,600 beds in 40 states and Puerto Rico. With approximately 25,000 employees serving more than 84,000 patients daily, Acadia is the largest stand-alone behavioral healthcare company in the U.S. Acadia provides behavioral healthcare services to its patients in a variety of settings, including inpatient psychiatric hospitals, specialty treatment facilities, RTCs and outpatient clinics.
